'''Scrabblescrew's Camp''' is a small [[goblin]] camp located not far from the [[Kodo Graveyard]] in [[Desolace]].{{coords|60.9|61.9|Desolace}} It is the home of [[Smeed Scrabblescrew]], an enterprising goblin who maintains a [[kodo]] [[caravan]].
